title: Wizard vs Istari: Middle-earth's Magic Users
script: This is a Wizard. This is an Istari. So what's the difference? Most people think they're interchangeable terms for magical beings. They're not. A 'Wizard' is a general term for magic-user in Middle-earth. An 'Istari' is a specific, powerful Maiar spirit sent by the Valar to aid mortals against Sauron, embodying a Wizard's form. That's why Gandalf *is an Istari*, while a random sorcerer *is just a wizard*. Follow for more.
